name: Ōgata (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ōgata village emblem in white: a stylised angular letter V with a bar at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Ōgata, a village in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1969.

features.role: Ōgata village emblem — a stylised angular letter V with a bar at the top
